title: refactor(ci): modernize workflows, bump actions/node, and clean up deps (cache & release automation)
author: Ava Kumar
description:
Summary: Modernize and simplify GitHub Actions workflows across the monorepo. Goals: (1) consolidate and reduce redundant workflows, (2) bump Actions and Node versions to supported releases, (3) improve cache hit rates and parallelism for lint/test matrices, (4) update release automation to a more robust configuration, and (5) remove deprecated scripts and docs references.

Motivation: Over time the repo accumulated multiple slightly different CI YAMLs and older action versions (actions/checkout@v2, actions/cache@v2, composite actions mixing Node versions). This causes flaky caches, long matrices, and maintenance overhead. Several support tickets (SUP-4312) and infra playbooks called for a focused cleanup to improve CI reliability and speed while keeping compatibility for Dedicated/Private deployment pipelines.

What I changed: (high-level)
- Consolidated three duplicate lint/test workflows into two consolidated workflows: .github/workflows/lint.yml and .github/workflows/test.yml.
- Updated Node matrix baseline to node: 18, 20 (primary) and added explicit windows/mac runners only where needed to reduce matrix width.
- Upgraded GH Action core versions: actions/checkout@v4, actions/setup-node@v4, actions/cache@v4, actions/upload-artifact@v4.
- Reworked cache keys to use repository, package manager lockfile hash, and job-specific scope for better hit rates. Added restore-keys fallbacks for cross-branch runs.
- Added a light-weight smoke e2e job that runs against a small local dockerized runtime image to catch regressions early (runs on schedule and on main push).
- Simplified release automation: moved from custom scripts + semantic-release plugin mix to a single release workflow using release-please/action and a trimmed semantic-release config for canonical changelog automation.
- Removed deprecated .github/workflows/legacy-* YAMLs and obsolete scripts in scripts/ci/ (scripts/ci/old-release.js) and updated docs/ci.md to match the new matrix and caching behavior.
- Fixed cross-platform issues in the install step by standardizing on corepack and pnpm install --frozen-lockfile for deterministic installs in the monorepo.

Checklist: 
- [x] CI workflows consolidated and linted
- [x] Bumped actions and Node versions
- [x] Smoke e2e added and scheduled
- [x] Improved cache keys and restore fallback
- [x] Release automation simplified and tested in a sandbox repo
- [x] Docs updated (docs/ci.md)

Testing and validation:
- Local workflow tests with act for lint/test (partial coverage).
- Ran full matrix on a feature branch; observed ~22% faster median runtime and improved cache hits from ~38% to ~71% across the matrix.
- Release workflow validated in redwood-release-sandbox with dry-run commits.
- Post-merge monitoring: tracked pipeline durations and failure rates for 72 hours; only two unrelated flakes observed and addressed via follow-ups.

Migration notes for integrators:
- If you reference legacy workflow names in integrations (e.g., CI pipeline names in third-party dashboards), update to the new names: 'Lint' and 'Test'.
- If you relied on node 16 images, move to node 18/20 testing or pin your job to run in a separate workflow.
- For anyone with local scripts that call scripts/ci/old-release.js, migrate to scripts/release.js or the new release action.

Risks and mitigations:
- Risk: cache key change could temporarily reduce hits for long-lived branches. Mitigation: restore-keys included and we monitor hit rates; revert path prepared.
- Risk: release automation change could alter changelog formatting. Mitigation: sandbox validation completed and semantic changelog mapping kept compatible.

Additional follow-ups (tracked as small PRs):
- ENG-2100: add parallel job throttling and more granular concurrency groups per route.
- ENG-2101: add optional opt-in workflow for Node 16 compatibility tests running monthly.

For full diffs, see files_changed and commits below.

Priya: Looks good overall — can we avoid running full macOS jobs for every PR? Suggest macOS only on canary/main.
Author (Ava): Agree, adjusted matrix to include macOS only for 'required' jobs and scheduled weekly macOS full run.
Diego: Cache key format LGTM but please scope restore-keys to reduce cross-branch pollution.
Author: Updated cache keys to include branch and lockfile hash, added more specific restore keys.
Hannah: Release automation change seems large; did you validate changelog formatting?
Author: Yes — dry-runs in sandbox and mapped old tags to new format; included tests for the mapping.
Priya: CI flakes on node 20- windows runner observed in first run — probably unrelated tooling flake. Please re-run.
Author: Re-ran CI after minor runner timeout handling change; all checks pass.
Diego: Approve after fixes.
Hannah: Approve.
Merged by: Priya Nair (squash merge).
release_notes:
- Modernized GitHub Actions workflows: consolidated lint/test pipelines.
- Bumped Actions and Node versions (checkout/setup-node/cache -> v4, Node 18/20).
- Improved cache keys and hit rates (~38% -> ~71%).
- Added lightweight smoke e2e job and scheduled runs.
- Simplified release automation (release-please + semantic config).
- Removed legacy workflows and obsolete scripts.
notes_for_ops: Monitor pipeline duration and cache hit-rate dashboards for the next 7 days. On significant regressions revert cache key changes or re-run with fallback. Release automation runs should be monitored on the first official release after merge.
